description: This is a unit test file for testing the behavior of a template class 'OptionalType' (probably similar to std::optional). It includes tests for construction, assignment, comparison, and value access of 'OptionalType' objects. The file uses Google Test framework for assertions and includes project-specific headers.

classes.name: OptionalType
classes.description: A template class that encapsulates an optional value of the specified type, supporting typical optional behaviors such as checking if a value is set, clearing the value, copying, and comparison.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the optional object to an unset state.

methods.name: IsSet
methods.description: Returns whether the optional object currently holds a value.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Accesses the stored value within the optional object.
